INSERT INTO status_stats (status_id, reblogs_count, created_at, updated_at)
           VALUES ($1, 1, now(), now())
           ON CONFLICT (status_id) DO UPDATE
             SET reblogs_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM statuses
                                  WHERE reblog_of_id = $1 AND deleted_at IS NULL),
                 updated_at = now()
